The selected wrapper emits a structured observation. Correctness and conformance determine its exit status; comparable elapsed time above 1346.059356 is ATTENTION, time at or below it is WITHIN, and a baseline identity mismatch is NOT_COMPARABLE.

Minimum-sufficient verification recognizes only the exact selected command, requires full_suite_reason, rejects malformed family invocations, and preserves the distinct BP-V4 measurement grammar and semantics.
An optional parallel-verification extra and prospective Brain authoring guidance support the selected command while retaining bp-v4-measurement and keeping pytest-xdist outside core dependencies.

The committed changes are confined to authorized files and introduce no global pytest parallel default, Runtime command rewrite, automatic selection, fallback, retry, timing correctness gate, or lifecycle authority.
